newsitem.title: CHINA: China grain base to boost output 2.0 mln T in 97.
newsitem.headline: China grain base to boost output 2.0 mln T in 97.

text.p: China's biggest grain grower, the northeastern province of Heilongjiang, plans to boost grain output by 2.0 million tonnes in 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Total grain production in the province was 30.5 million tonnes in 1996, up 4.5 million tonnes from the year before, Xinhua quoted a provincial official as saying.

The province had set a target of 32.5 million tonnes for 1997, with the increase to come from improving 100,000 hectares of low-yield land and reclaiming 133,000 hectares of wasteland, the agency but gave no further details.
China reaped a record grain harvest of 490 million tonnes in 1996, up from a previous record crop of 465 million tonnes the year before.
